mechanism: Iterative controller-code revision with accumulated rollout evidence and physical priors within a design problem
evidence_scope: Agents receive a candidate controller, accumulated rollout evidence and physical priors, then propose changes to the controller's logic and parameters.
evidence_role: we show how self-evolving scientific agents can design explicit, neural-network-free white-box controllers by iteratively interpreting simulation evidence, accumulat- ing control knowledge and refining controller code.
